title: Grouped runs can produce duplicate bars and legend entries
reasoning: The iteration table deduplicates all five selected columns, including run_date, but the loop selects data using only display_name. When grouped runs share a display_name and have different dates, the loop processes that group repeatedly, adding identical aggregate bars to every panel and repeatedly requesting a legend entry.
reproduction: Provide grouped checkpoint data with two run_path values sharing a display_name but having different run_date values. The function adds ten traces instead of five for that display group.
recommendation: Sort the run metadata first, then deduplicate by the display-group identity used by the loop so each group is rendered once.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied file contains chart implementation, not pytest tests. No supplied test asserts trace counts for grouped runs with different dates.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise grouped data with varying run dates and multiple display groups; assert exactly five traces per display group and verify each aggregate includes every constituent run once.
minimumFixScope: The sorted_unique_runs construction in build_test_pass_rate_bars and behavioral chart coverage.
